_about: Where things live and how videos are checked. Paths are relative to the project folder. To change something on one machine only (for example the Mac), put just those keys in server/settings.local.json; it is never committed.
_device: auto = cuda (NVIDIA), then mps (Mac), then cpu. Or name one. With no video packages installed yet, it is 'none'.
_use_3060_settings: For a 12 GB graphics card like the RTX 3060: parts of the model wait in normal memory until they're needed (CPU offloading), and frames are turned into pixels in tiles. Slower, but it fits. Not needed on the Mac. Switched on the Settings page, which saves it in settings.local.json.
_custom: Where the Custom tab starts (its own theme, no theme file behind it). The model is the first one in the models folder unless named here. frames: how many pictures the video has; at fps of them a second, 81 frames at 16 fps is about 5 seconds.

custom.negative: blurry, low quality, jittery, flickering, distorted, deformed, text, watermark, still image

_max_videos: Most videos one Generate can make (Advanced tab).
_unload_after_minutes: Let go of the model when no videos have been made for this long, so the graphics memory is free. The next video then takes longer to start. 0 = let go as soon as the queue is empty.
_max_queue: Most video jobs waiting or being made at once. More requests are turned away until some finish.
_lock: Ask for a six-digit code before anything on the site can be seen. A server option, not on the website: turn it on in server/settings.local.json (never here, so the code isn't committed) with "lock": true and "lock_code": "123456", then restart the server. A browser that typed the code isn't asked again for 30 days; a new code asks everyone again.

safety._about: Frames from every video are checked by both checkers (one frame in every 'every_frames', plus the last). The video is not shown if either checker scores any of them at or above the threshold. Up to 'tries' videos are made before giving up. 'negative' is added to every theme's negative prompt.
safety.negative: nsfw, nude, nudity, naked, topless, nipples, genitals, explicit, sexual
